mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_itinerary_solo_meta ( project_id, total_score, safety, transport_accessibility, route_simplicity, landmark_accessibility, solo_dining_difficulty, summary, recommendation ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{solo.soloScore.totalScore}, #{solo.soloScore.safety}, #{solo.soloScore.transportAccessibility}, #{solo.soloScore.routeSimplicity}, #{solo.soloScore.landmarkAccessibility}, #{solo.soloScore.soloDiningDifficulty}, #{solo.summary}, #{solo.recommendation} )
mapper.select: SELECT total_score AS totalScore, safety, transport_accessibility AS transportAccessibility, route_simplicity AS routeSimplicity, landmark_accessibility AS landmarkAccessibility, solo_dining_difficulty AS soloDiningDifficulty, summary FROM project_itinerary_solo_meta WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
